producer: same FailureSink definition in protocol.py and guard-failed-red.bash
nullMeans: Not observed/validated; never backfilled by later observations
waited: Only actual returned integer child.wait result; communication completion is recorded before waiting
descriptorOwnership: System.resources plus Custody.OWNED retain before validation; failed closes retained without retry. Bootstrap FD ledger appends immediately after open.
failureAcquisition: Popen child strong reference appended before reading or validating pid; pending child retained on unknown completion
operatorObligation: Separately capture the exact outer tool output/status, retain immutable failure trace and consumed shell attempt; seek separately reviewed disposition. This source does not infer OS exit/orphan state.
boundedMetadataOmitted: True explicitly marks an invalid/oversized optional metadata value omitted from the closed trace; never truncates or drops a known provisional child or requested command.
